summary.text: Kristine Reeves is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 30-Position 2 since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Paul McDaniel.

paragraphs.text: Kristine Reeves was born in Moses Lake, Washington, and lives in Federal Way, Washington.

Reeves graduated from Moses Lake Senior High School in 1999, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Washington State University in 2004, and received a master's in organizational leadership from Gonzaga University in 2007.

Reeves' career experience includes working as a statewide veterans constituency coordinator, South Sound regional director, and Kitsap & Olympic Peninsula director for U.S. Senator Patty Murray, and as the economic development director for the Military and Defense sector for Washington state.
Reeves assumed office in the Washington House on January 9, 2023.

Her 2023-2024 committee assignments included the Rural Development, Agriculture, and Natural Resources Committee, the Consumer Protection & Business Committee, where she was vice chair, and the Commerce & Gaming Committee.
